title: InventoryFilter
description: Automatically removes unwanted items from your inventory based on a configurable filter.
body:
# 🧹 Inventory Filter

**Tired of junk items cluttering your inventory?** Inventory Filter automatically removes items you don't want — so you can focus on what matters.

---

## ✨ How It Works

Craft the **Filter** item and open it to configure which items should be automatically deleted from your inventory. Once set, any matching item that enters your inventory will be instantly removed — no more manual cleanup.

---

## 🔧 Features

- **9 filter slots** — configure up to 9 different item types to filter out
- **Automatic deletion** — filtered items are removed the moment they enter your inventory
- **Persistent settings** — your filter configuration is saved to the item, take it anywhere
- **Lightweight** — no performance impact, works seamlessly in singleplayer and multiplayer

---

## 📖 Usage

1. Craft the **Inventory Filter** item
2. Right-click to open the filter GUI
3. Click a filter slot and then click any item to add it to the filter
4. Close the GUI — the filter is now active!

To disable filtering for an item, simply click its slot in the filter GUI with an empty hand.

---
